n: Eligible participant count for ROI inference; in cell_event_counts.csv n is trial opportunities, not participant count. N<2 estimate cells blank.
df: Degrees of freedom; one-sample imaging tests use N-1.
mean: Arithmetic group mean, suppressed for N<2; see file dictionary for units.
ci_low: Lower pointwise 95% interval; see model-specific scale in file dictionary.
ci_high: Upper pointwise 95% interval; see model-specific scale in file dictionary.
q_within_contrast: BH across 48 planned slots within model, coverage policy and stage.
q_joint_stages: BH across 192 planned slots within model and coverage policy.
q_enumerated_models_stages: Exploratory BH across 1728 enumerated slots within coverage policy; not a correction for model/ROI/policy selection.
q_three_pairs_144: BH across three direct stage pairs x 48 planned slots within policy.
q_within_pair_48: Supplementary BH across 48 slots for one direct pair and policy.
q_bh_24: BH across 24 behavioral contrasts per RT policy; untested slots have p=1.
model: Updated reference means uncensored reference (primary N22); censored and alternative specifications are sensitivities. Historical v1.0.0 labels have earlier post hoc reporting roles.
policy: Coverage or RT validity policy; consult analysis specification.
roi: Atlas parcel identifier. SMA legacy names denote the whole BA6 parcel, not an SMA-specific subdivision.
stage: Initial, early, middle or late contrast; the initial contrast is a within-phase condition difference.
pair: Direct subtraction of the named phases.
log_rt: Fixed-effect natural log RT in milliseconds; exponentiation gives geometric milliseconds.
log_difference: Contrast of log RT; exponentiation gives geometric RT ratio.
q: BH 48 planned ROI slots per cohort/model/policy/contrast or stage; missing p treated as 1. See AGGREGATE_CHECK_SPEC.json.
cohort: N22 primary; overlapping learner-selected N20 sensitivity, supplement only.
q_joint_stages_192: BH across 4 stages x 48 regions per cohort/model/policy; missing p is 1.
q_joint_192: BH across 4 stages x 48 regions per cohort/model/policy.
q_headline_early_4: BH across the four displayed early regions per cohort/model/policy/component.
condition_mean: (structured change + random change)/2, phase-mean coefficient units.
bootstrap_log_ci_low: Saved whole-participant percentile interval lower limit; natural log RT contrast.
n_participants: Participant count contributing to a group design summary; singleton duration cells are blank.
n_aligned: Number of eligible participants in the slice-timing-aligned sensitivity.
mean_aligned: Saved group mean for the slice-timing-aligned sensitivity; blank when suppressed.
mean_shift: Descriptive aligned-minus-reference mean difference; blank if either side is suppressed.
q_BH48: Saved Benjamini-Hochberg q across all 48 parcel slots within the specified cohort, phase and contrast.
q_BH4: Saved Benjamini-Hochberg q for the four continuing-sequence headline parcels within cohort and phase; other slots blank.
phase: For the continuing-sequence benchmark, early uses runs 3–4, middle uses runs 5–6, and the initial baseline uses runs 1–2; other files retain their source-defined phase labels.
continuing_mean: Continuing-sequence two-run summed difference in differences; blank when suppressed.
new_sequence_mean: Early new-sequence two-run summed difference in differences; blank when suppressed.
paired_difference_mean: Participant-paired early new-minus-continuing difference, twice the two-run mean Str2-minus-Str1; blank when suppressed.
